notes: 1) There are many cords missing in the first ca. half of this khipu (i.e. up to section beginning with cord 127). I suspect that originally, this first half contained an arrangement similar to that of the second half (i.e. cord groups of ca. 36 cords/group). 2) Cords 28-31 are knotted at mid-cord (9.0 cm.) by cord 29. Due to knotting, it is different to determine which lower cord goes with which upper cord. However, all have the same value (5) Center of knotted cords is at 9.5 cm. 3) Cords 56-61 (like cords 28-31) are tied together by cord #56 at 8.0 cm. All carry value 5. It is difficult to sort out relations between upper and lower sets of cords (the readings in teh table are my best reconstruction of connections). 4) Cords 127-132 form what I interpret as an "accounting group." Cords 127 + 129 are free (i.e. not knotted together) and each records value 10. Cords 128 + 130-132 are knot
